subject: The honest truth about why this app exists
preview_text: I need to confess something. Building this app was the easy part. What came next changed everything.
body_paragraphs: I was sitting in my 4th meeting of the day, my notebook a mess of scribbles, when I realized I had no idea what the first three meetings were actually about. The panic was real. I built the first version of Smart Notes that night, just for me. But here's the thing.

Honestly, building this app wouldn't mean anything without people like you. Seeing someone reclaim an hour of their day, or walk into a meeting confident they'll catch every detail... that's the whole point. It turns a solo project into a shared secret weapon. You're the reason this thing has a heartbeat.

That's why the 'Smart Search' feature is my favorite. It’s not just a search bar. It’s your personal memory bank. Forget a client's name from a month ago? Search a keyword. Need the action items from last quarter's planning session? It's there. It turns your chaotic note history into a superpower.

Open the app right now and type one word into the search bar. See what you rediscover. It’ll take 10 seconds and you might find a gem you totally forgot about. P.S. The most searched term last week was 'budget'. Just saying.
